title: Add API Explorer UI protocol for browsing, testing, and documenting APIs
body:
## Problem

ObjectStack has API Registry and Documentation schemas but no UI specifications for building API management interfaces. Need comprehensive UI protocol for browsing, testing, and managing APIs.

## Solution

Added `api-explorer.zod.ts` with 6 component schemas that compose into complete API management UIs:

### Component Schemas

- **`ApiBrowserComponent`** - Sidebar navigation with grouping (type/status/tag/owner), filtering, search
- **`ApiEndpointViewerComponent`** - Main content with 5 modes (documentation/testing/code/schema/combined)
- **`ApiTestingPlaygroundComponent`** - Postman-style testing with request/response editors, environments, collections
- **`ApiDocumentationViewerComponent`** - Multiple doc styles (swagger/redoc/slate/stoplight)
- **`ApiHealthMonitorComponent`** - Real-time metrics, alerts, performance tracking
- **`ApiExplorerPageSchema`** - Complete page configuration with flexible layouts

### Architecture

Aligns with industry patterns: Swagger UI (interactive docs), Postman (testing), ReDoc (documentation), Kong Manager (gateway UI).

Integrates with existing protocols:
- `api/registry.zod.ts` - Data source
- `api/documentation.zod.ts` - Doc generation
- `permission/*.zod.ts` - Access control

### Usage

```typescript
import { ApiExplorer } from '@objectstack/spec/ui';

const page = ApiExplorer.createPage({
  name: 'api_explorer',
  label: 'API Explorer',
  layout: 'sidebar-main',
  sidebar: {
    type: 'api-browser',
    groupBy: 'type',
    showSearch: true
  },
  main: {
    type: 'api-endpoint-viewer',
    defaultMode: 'combined',
    enableTesting: true,
    codeLanguages: ['typescript', 'python', 'curl']
  },
  enableHealthMonitor: true
});
```

### Files

- `api-explorer.zod.ts` (666 lines) - Schemas and factory helpers
- `api-explorer.test.ts` (808 lines) - 49 tests, full coverage
- `api-explorer.example.ts` (632 lines) - 10 production examples
- `API_EXPLORER.md` (496 lines) - Complete guide
